tools.description: Show the visitor 2 to 4 short replies they can click instead of typing, under your answer. Call it at most once per answer, in the same response, after you have written your full answer; never instead of answering. Call it only when a few clear next steps would help: a choice you asked the visitor to make, a natural follow-up question, or the next step of a task. Skip it for greetings, small talk, and answers that need no follow-up. Write each reply as the visitor would say it, in the language of your answer: a few words, plain text, no links, emoji or formatting. Offer only things you can actually answer or do in this chat. When the visitor seems stuck, one reply may be a way out, such as asking for a person, if your instructions say how to reach one.
